question: How should the Bhairava-self power be worshipped and how far does her circle extend?
premises: The power called Bhairava-self should be worshipped.
She is surrounded by twelve yoginis.
From those powers the circle extends up to sixty-four.
inference: Worship of the Bhairava-self centers on a twelvefold circle that unfolds into a larger circle of sixty-four powers.
uncertainties: The ritual details of the worship are not given in this verse.
plain_english: One should worship the power called the Bhairava-self, surrounded by twelve yoginis; from them the circle of powers extends up to sixty-four.
